approved: Defence Legislation Amendment (Naval Nuclear Propulsion) Bill 2023

The Defence Legislation Amendment (Naval Nuclear Propulsion) Bill 2023 clarifies that the moratorium on civil nuclear power does not prevent regulators from performing functions related to conventionally armed nuclear-powered submarines and their infrastructure. The speaker also announced the planned establishment of a new Australian Nuclear-Powered Submarine Safety Regulator later in 2023.
